children: On September 14, on-chain analyst Ai Yi (@ai_9684xtpa) monitored an address identified as 0x7d7...3b54a that had bought $500,000 worth of 4Stock five days earlier at an average price of $0.05078.
According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, the address sold the entire position four hours ago at $0.01983, cutting losses after holding for five days.
The whale lost $304,000 over the period, and its assets shrank by 60.7%.

title: Whale Sells 4Stock Position at a Loss After Five Days
